name: commerce
description: Vendor shopping verbs (shop/browse/buy/sell) and balance display. Vendor services (stock, pricing, trust, restock) stay engine.

shop.note: KNOWN GAP: vendor NPC verb; examine shows only talk/attack for NPCs. Discoverable via the click-a-vendor shop panel / dialogue, not examine.

browse.note: KNOWN GAP: alias of shop; same NPC gap.

buy.note: KNOWN GAP: targets on-scene vendor via resolveVendor; NPC-gated, discoverable via shop panel.

sell.note: KNOWN GAP: targets on-scene vendor via resolveVendor; NPC-gated, discoverable via shop panel.
